text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Suzuka is terrifyingly fast after all!
Air Groove-senpai, what fierce spirit!
Bright too—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Ghh, no. No, no, that's not it!
...'I' am!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(The weakness that makes me hide in someone else's shadow—
I'm leaving it behind right here, right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I will win! I'll show them I can win!
As myself, as Mejiro Dober!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ngh, aaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa, haa, haa—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(...Strange.
I can't... hear the cheers... at all.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (It's quiet. And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Right here is something on the verge of bursting.
Thump-thump, it's beating, hot and pulsing.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (That's right, 'I' am...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (To everyone running in the same era—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (To the rivals aiming for that same glory—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (To the idol who guided me—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: —I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Win, win, win!
I... want to prove my strength!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I am the pinnacle, the strongest!
Rewriting the past, remembered through future generations—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"The New Glory of Mejiro"!
I want to become... "Mejiro Dober"...!!
choice_data_list: So you were able to face it, Dober.
You were able to face it, weren't you, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to face it.
Facing it... helped me find the 'real me.'"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's why..., ...yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Let me ask you properly once again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want our next goal to be the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I heard Air Groove-senpai is going to run in it.
That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup
with Air Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
To the senior who gave me so much.
To my ideal, who taught and guided me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want to challenge, win—
and become "Mejiro Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah...!!

The showdown will be in autumn. At the prestigious Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
where peerless queens gather.

To get into peak condition, we set the
Fuchu Umamusume Stakes as an interim goal, and—
Together with Mejiro Dober, I take the first step forward.
